definitions.explanation: The bony framework of a human or animal body. In everyday usage, often refers to a skeleton model or a skull-and-crossbones image.

examples.japanese: {理科室|りかしつ}に{骸骨|がいこつ}の{模型|もけい}がある。
examples.english: There is a skeleton model in the science room.

examples.japanese: ハロウィンの{飾|かざ}りに{骸骨|がいこつ}を{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used skeletons as Halloween decorations.

examples.japanese: {洞窟|どうくつ}の{奥|おく}で{古|ふる}い{骸骨|がいこつ}が{発見|はっけん}された。
examples.english: An old skeleton was discovered deep inside the cave.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both real skeletons and decorative/symbolic ones. The skull-and-crossbones symbol (pirate flag, poison warning) is also called {骸骨|がいこつ}マーク.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {骸骨|がいこつ}の{模型|もけい} (skeleton model)
- {骸骨|がいこつ}マーク (skull-and-crossbones symbol)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {骨格|こっかく}: skeletal frame — more technical/anatomical
- {頭蓋骨|ずがいこつ}: skull — specifically the skull
